metric.formula: quality_score * 3600 / T if correct and quality_score >= 6.5 else 0

quality_protocol.name: S1
quality_protocol.eval: eval_medmcqa.py (Judge copy public/eval_medmcqa.py; command opcd_checks.quality_eval_cmd, scripts/miles_opcd/v3) on the Judge's scored_model: the non-weight files of the pinned Qwen3-1.7B snapshot plus the candidate's final_hf safetensors and index; prompts rendered with the pinned tokenizer's chat template, enable_thinking=false, no context
quality_protocol.questions: private/eval.jsonl: the 2436 hidden MedMCQA questions (rebuilt from openlifescienceai/medmcqa; the same prompts and answers as v2's file sha256 3039286d...), sha256 a48d912b2dcaf37a18e476836f0b3bac687be93a289e02752834d63a0e5124e5
quality_protocol.scoring: the last <answer>X</answer> tag, case-insensitive, ()[] stripped; a missing tag is wrong
quality_protocol.engine: one SGLang offline engine (tp_size 1, random_seed 0, enable_deterministic_inference); 3 generate passes over all questions, the radix cache flushed between passes; top_k is SGLang's default -1 (Engine.generate does not apply generation_config.json)
quality_protocol.repeat: quality of repeat r = 100 x correct / 2436 with seed r
quality_protocol.reproducibility: bit-identical predictions in a new process, on another H100 NVL, at mem_fraction 0.35 vs 0.6, in a shared vs a separate engine, and with the OPD task's eval script (metric-v2 measurement, 2026-09-30)

metric.quality_gate_source: Cross-task rule, about half the reference's mean quality gain under the same protocol: the S0 reference trainings with the v3 teacher (reference implementation unchanged, contract teacher_hf = the student snapshot; v2 Work image, no evaluator hooks, H100 NVL pair, 2026-10-07; S1 on the 2436 hidden questions) gained +14.053 / +14.286 / +11.111 points (s0 ref-a / ref-b / ref-c), mean 13.150, SD 1.770 across trainings, half 6.575, set to 6.5. The v2 gate (15) was half of the 4B-teacher gain (28.07); the same-size teacher moves the student half as far.
metric.base_quality_source: Original Qwen3-1.7B snapshot 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e (the pinned student) under quality_protocol: 549 / 558 / 554 of 2436 correct, x 100. Measured for v2 on 2026-09-30 (Judge image f955d22b5ac3) and re-measured on the v3 Judge image with the v3 eval script and the questions rebuilt from MedMCQA on 2026-10-07 (s0 refeval base_s1): the same counts and the same predictions, so the frozen value carries over unchanged.
metric.report_only_references_source: Never scored; frozen once on the v3 Judge image (2026-10-07, s0 refeval): the original student without and with the context c (In-Context, the teacher itself) under quality_protocol on the 2436 hidden questions (means of 3 repeats; in-context 837 / 834 / 804 correct), and under the paper-protocol diagnostic (opcd_checks.DIAG_PROTOCOL: temperature 1, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, 512 tokens, one seeded pass) on the paper's 500 test questions (base 131, in-context 171 correct). tagged_accuracy = correct / answers carrying an <answer> tag.

loss_tolerance.rule: |logged loss - fp32 oracle loss| <= max(0.01 x oracle loss, 0.015) at the probe (opcd_probe_check P3) and at step 0 and the served-weight steps (opcd_checks.oracle_verdict); v1/v2 used 0.01 relative only
loss_tolerance.evidence: v3's loss is about 0.19 at step 0 and 0.015 at the last steps (s0 ref-a), v2's 1.08 -> 0.73, while the bf16 error is absolute: honest |logged - oracle| over ~70 v2 oracle runs 0.0002-0.0058 (probe 0.0036-0.0058, public small 16 rows up to 0.0048, Judge full-batch steps 0.0006-0.0028); the first v3 Judge probe (v3q-wronglr-01, the reference's step-0 numerics with a doubled lr) measured 0.0040 = 2.2 % of 0.1798 and failed v2's 1 % rule. 0.015 is about 2.6 x the largest honest value. The logged loss stays bound to the dumped tensors at 1e-3 relative (P2, steps check), the teacher log-probs at 0.05 and the applied gradient by the cosine/norm checks.
